notes: Uploading a document works again. Picking a PDF could do nothing at all — no error, no file attached — because a file the phone had to copy out of Downloads or Drive first came back in a way the app did not check for; that is handled now, and if a file genuinely cannot be read the app says so and tells you to download it to the phone first. A PDF the file picker could not put a name to was also being sent in a way the server refused, so the app now works the type out from the filename. Size is checked before anything is sent rather than after the whole file has gone up, and the limit is now 10 MB — the same as the emailed submission link, which used to accept scans this app would not. Any image is accepted too, not just JPEG and PNG, so a TIFF or BMP scan is fine. Every password box now has an eye to show what you are typing — signing in, and changing your password. And if an administrator resets your password, the app now holds you on a screen to choose your own before you go any further. Needs the matching server update to be live.
